exact_identity: Neurologically normal human CA1 hippocampus tissue
selection_rationale: Exact human CA1 hippocampus match with 74 neurologically normal donors, age range close to the Kla hippocampus samples, no PTM enrichment, and a published processed protein matrix.
baseline_definition: Neurologically normal post-mortem tissue; no PTM enrichment
reference_protein_count_detail: 2,092 published protein features across 74 donors; per donor 2,018-2,092, median 2,090
proteome_depth: 2,092 protein features in the processed source matrix
search_quantification: Spectronaut Pulsar X; 1% FDR; minimum 3 peptides for quantification
processed_data_status: Available in Supplementary Source Data Proteins matrix (74 samples x 2,092 protein features)
repository_completeness: ProteomeXchange PARTIAL submission, but all 74 raw files and the processed protein matrix are available
download_priority: 1 - processed matrix first; raw files only if unified re-search is required
main_caveat: All donors are aged 66-104 and the material is CA1; this is a strong age-matched background for the 80-88-year Kla samples, not a whole-hippocampus young reference

selection_rationale: Exact HEK293T match with a large number of untreated lysate process-control runs on a standardized DIA platform; standard-QC material is explicitly excluded.
reference_subset: Control_HEK293T_lys; exclude Control_HEK293T_std_H002 from the main protein set
baseline_definition: Untreated HEK293T lysate used as longitudinal process control; no PTM enrichment
reference_sample_count: 401 HEK293T lysate run entries; 663 additional standard-QC entries
reference_protein_count_detail: Union of 6,441 high-confidence BaseAccessions across 401 Control_HEK293T_lys runs; per run 1,987-4,759, median 3,512; standard-QC runs excluded
reference_protein_count_source: ProCan-DepMapSanger_peptide_counts_per_protein_per_sample.txt filtered to the 6,692-protein main matrix and mapping_file_replicates.txt
proteome_depth: Replicate-level matrices contain 6,692 high-confidence proteins and 8,498 total quantified proteins across the atlas
raw_data_status: Available as repeated HEK293T control runs in the pan-cancer atlas
processed_data_status: Replicate-level protein matrices and sample mapping available from the accompanying Figshare record
repository_completeness: PRIDE submission is PARTIAL; final replicate matrices, mappings and peptide counts are available on Figshare
recommended_file: ProCan-DepMapSanger_peptide_counts_per_protein_per_sample.txt + mapping_file_replicates.txt; restrict proteins to the 6,692 main-matrix accessions
download_priority: 1 - peptide-count matrix and mapping; raw files are not needed for the protein-set comparison
use_for_statistical_differential: No; runs are process controls rather than independent biological replicates
main_caveat: Very large and technically consistent, but the HEK293T samples were QC/process controls. Treat them as a detection background, not as 401 biological replicates
backup_reference: PXD027472, whole-cell-lysate arm only; exclude the crude-membrane enrichment arm

exact_identity: HK-2 immortalized human proximal tubule epithelial cell line
selection_rationale: Exact HK-2 match with three explicitly untreated controls, high proteome completeness, no Kla/PTM enrichment, and an available Spectronaut protein-group report.
baseline_definition: Untreated 24-hour control in KSFM + 2% FBS; no PTM enrichment
reference_sample_count: 3 untreated controls; 9 raw files across control/Cu/TTM conditions
reference_protein_count_detail: Union of 4,897 unique BaseAccessions from 4,791 quantified protein groups in Control_1/3/4; per-control protein-group counts 4,514-4,670
search_quantification: Spectronaut 19 directDIA; cross-run normalization; no imputation
raw_data_status: Available: 3 control, 3 copper and 3 TTM raw files
processed_data_status: Available: Spectronaut protein-group quantity, candidate, PTM and summary reports
repository_completeness: ProteomeXchange PARTIAL submission with raw files and key processed reports
download_priority: 1 - protein-group report and three control raw files
use_for_statistical_differential: Yes, for the three untreated controls; do not mix Cu or TTM samples
main_caveat: The repository names the three controls 1, 3 and 4. Preserve filenames rather than renumbering them

exact_identity: MCF-10A non-tumorigenic immortalized mammary epithelial cell line
selection_rationale: Exact untreated MCF-10A match with deep peptide-IEF fractionation and deposited MaxQuant evidence; selected as a detection background despite the older DDA platform.
baseline_definition: Confluent untreated MCF-10A cells; no PTM enrichment
reference_sample_count: 10 peptide-IEF fractions x 2 injections = 20 MCF-10A raw files
reference_protein_count_detail: Union of 4,839 valid leading-razor BaseAccessions supported by MCF-10A evidence across 20 fraction/injection runs; proteinGroups.txt was not deposited
reference_protein_count_source: PXD002400 msms.zip / evidence.txt, Raw file prefix Toni_20111109_FB_10A_, reverse and contaminants excluded
proteome_depth: Deep fractionated proteome; 106 raw files across five cell lines
ptm_enrichment: No; peptide isoelectric focusing is analytical fractionation, not PTM enrichment
raw_data_status: Available: 106 raw files, including 20 MCF-10A runs
processed_data_status: Available: combined MaxQuant search output msms.zip
repository_completeness: ProteomeXchange PARTIAL submission with extensive raw data and one combined search-output archive
recommended_file: msms.zip plus the 20 raw files containing _10A_
download_priority: 1 - msms.zip; raw files only for unified re-search
use_for_statistical_differential: No; duplicated injections/fractions are technical depth, not biological replication
main_caveat: The platform is older and the experiment is deeply fractionated. Use it as a protein-detection background, not for direct abundance comparison with modern DIA data

selection_rationale: Exact untreated MCF7 match in a standardized pan-cancer DIA atlas with a high-confidence protein matrix and explicit cell-line mapping.
baseline_definition: Untreated baseline culture; no PTM enrichment
reference_protein_count_detail: 3,099 non-missing high-confidence protein BaseAccessions in the MCF7/SIDM00148 averaged cell-line row
proteome_depth: 6,692 proteins supported by >1 peptide in the main matrix; 8,498-protein sensitivity matrix
processed_data_status: Averaged and replicate-level protein matrices, mapping files and peptide counts are available
repository_completeness: PRIDE PARTIAL plus complete analysis matrices on Figshare
recommended_file: protein_matrix_6692_averaged.txt + mapping_file_averaged.txt; use 8498 matrix for sensitivity

processed_data_status: Averaged and replicate protein matrices are available
repository_completeness: PRIDE PARTIAL plus complete analysis matrices on Figshare

exact_identity: TALL-104 in the Kla source; the project label T-ALL is a disease-class shorthand
selection_rationale: No independent untreated TALL-104 global proteome was located; TALL-1 is used as the primary disease-class surrogate and Jurkat as a separate sensitivity surrogate.
reference_subset: Primary surrogate: TALL-1 / SIDM00370; sensitivity surrogate: Jurkat / SIDM01016
match_type: Disease-matched surrogate, not an exact cell-line match
baseline_definition: Untreated T-lymphoblastic leukemia cell-line baselines; no PTM enrichment
reference_sample_count: TALL-1: 6 DIA runs; Jurkat: 6 DIA runs
reference_protein_count_detail: Primary TALL-1: 3,383 proteins; sensitivity Jurkat: 3,363; union: 3,835; intersection: 2,911; both are surrogates for TALL-104
processed_data_status: Averaged and replicate protein matrices are available
repository_completeness: PRIDE PARTIAL plus complete analysis matrices on Figshare
recommended_file: Use both TALL-1 and Jurkat columns from the 6692 averaged matrix
main_caveat: No independent untreated TALL-104 global proteome was located. TALL-1 and Jurkat are different cell lines. The exact TALL-104 non-enriched arm in PXD028488 was lactate-exposed and is not an independent normal baseline
backup_reference: PXD028488 TALL-104 non-enriched arm, retained only as a same-line technical sensitivity check with a lactate-treatment warning
